summary: This is a configuration file defining a user profile with two pieces of information: an email address and a display name. It's formatted as a simple key-value structure under a [user] section header, likely for storing user identity details that an application can read.

explanations.1: The square brackets denote a section header, grouping related settings together — everything below it belongs to the 'user' section until the next header appears.
explanations.2: This assigns the email address 'me@work.be' to a variable or setting called 'email' so the application knows how to contact or identify this user.
explanations.3: This assigns the full name 'Christophe Avonture' to a setting called 'name' for display purposes throughout the application.
